settings_compliance_intro: GDPR retention policy, the record of erasure requests you have honored, and the record of AI-assisted content.
settings_compliance_retention_desc: How long signed agreements and signatures are kept before they are permanently destroyed.
settings_compliance_retention_note: Retained as a legal obligation under GDPR Art. 17(3)(e) (defence of legal claims). The default of 6 years matches the UK simple-contract limitation period. Note: deleted rows remain restorable from D1 Time-Travel backups for up to 30 days.
settings_compliance_pdf_desc: How long a rendered report PDF is kept before the file and its record are permanently destroyed. Enter 0 to keep them indefinitely.
settings_compliance_pdf_note: Platform default: 7 years. This is a platform-selected default for when you have not chosen a period. It is not a statutory retention period, and not a representation that seven years is the maximum legally required period. The default is informed primarily by defence of legal claims and secondarily by record-retention rules: Illinois requires five years for home-inspection contracts, reports and supporting data, with a longer period where a qualifying judicial proceeding extends two years beyond final disposition; Virginia and Washington identify three-year periods for specified home-inspection records. Your own choice controls wherever the law permits it.
settings_compliance_views_desc: Whether this workspace records that a recipient opened a report, and how many times.
settings_compliance_views_note: Off unless you turn it on. When enabled, we record the first and most recent time each recipient opened a report and how often — no page, scroll or device detail. Counting is suppressed for your own previews, for the PDF renderer, and for browser prefetches, so the number reflects people rather than machines. It is a signal, not proof of receipt: a link checker that behaves like a browser is indistinguishable from a reader. Any recipient can object to being counted, and that objection is honoured for them alone.
settings_compliance_pdf_range_error: Enter a whole number of years between 0 and 99. Use 0 to keep report PDFs indefinitely.
settings_compliance_offline_desc: How long the mobile and desktop apps can stay offline before they lock local data until the next sign-in.
